title: Cross-functional OKR Anchor Map and Initiative Release Signatures
creator: Asha Kapoor
description: Problem: company-level OKRs are currently expressed as outcomes but there is no single canonical mapping to the set of ongoing initiatives across PM/Eng/Design. That causes duplicate work, unclear critical paths to objective completion, and brittle release gating. Goal: produce an "Initiative Anchor Map" that ties each company OKR to a prioritized set of initiatives and a lightweight "Release Signature" for each initiative. The Release Signature is a one-page artifact that captures owner, primary success metrics, required upstream dependencies, gating criteria for rollout, rollback conditions, and a link to verification artifacts. This ticket scopes creation of the mapping schema, a pilot for top 6 OKRs, onboarding of three partner teams (Serving Runtime, Console, Dedicated), and a rollout plan for the broader org.
acceptance_criteria: Initiative Anchor Map created that links 100% of active company-level OKRs to at least one initiative
Release Signature template approved and populated for at least 75% of initiatives mapped to those OKRs (target: 18/24)
Cross-functional review completed with signoffs from Eng TLs, Design lead, and Security for pilot initiatives
A living dashboard (Looker/Console) displays OKR -> initiative coverage and highlights critical-path dependencies
Onboarding doc and a PR template for new Release Signatures added to the PM playbook (Confluence)
notes: Trade-offs: deep per-initiative signatures increase fidelity but add maintenance overhead. We will keep signatures intentionally lightweight (1 page) and automate updates from Jira where possible.

Decision: canonical source for the Anchor Map will be a version-controlled CSV/YAML in the pm-playbooks repo with Confluence as the narrative layer. This avoids divergent copies and enables programmatic checks.

Risk: some teams are already tracking bespoke success metrics; harmonization will require 1:1 alignment sessions. Mitigation: require each Release Signature to declare a canonical metric and an alias mapping to the team's internal dashboard.
Scope boundary: this ticket does not retrofit historical initiatives prior to 2025-Q3 except as notes; we focus on current live initiatives and those in the next two quarters.
